investigation.brief: Annapurna Sweets & Snacks saw daily volume average ₹7,12,588 over the last 48 hours against a declared baseline of ₹42,584. Settlement was expected at ₹14,07,622 but only ₹7,82,842 arrived, leaving a gap of ₹6,24,780. The merchant profile declares a single Pune outlet with terminals T-01 and T-02 processing about ₹40,000 daily, whereas activity shifted to new terminal(s) T-09 in Jaipur. Additionally, 32 payments totaling ₹13,40,000 are flagged, 94.0% of volume came from T-09 between midnight and 6 am, and the top three payers comprised 94.0% of transactions. This is a recommendation for review, not a finding of fraud.

recommended.title: Hold the next settlement and verify the activity
steps: Place the next settlement batch on hold pending review (a person decides; the agent has not moved any money).
Ask the merchant for invoices or contracts for the largest flagged payments and for the top repeating payers.
Confirm with the merchant whether terminal T-09 in Jaipur is theirs (Voice Chase can call them).
Review the chargebacks with the acquirer: they are debited from settlement and often signal card testing.
Close the investigation as resolved or dismiss it as a false positive, with a note.
